name: Madara
description: The empire Tor and Tetsuo serve.

description_citations.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas, impressed by his ambition, names Overdark imperial regent.
timeline.quote: Bolas then awarded Overdark with the title of imperial regent.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kolo Meha destroys Overdark's keep at Tetsuo's order, killing Zalgadib.
timeline.quote: Kolo Meha was ordered to destroy the keep by Tetsuo Umezawa, killing Zalgadib.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas usurps power in Madara and becomes god-emperor.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas usurps the power in Madara , becoming its new god-emperor.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa ends the Madara-Edemi War, slaying Nicol Bolas among others.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo Umezawa slays Xira Arien , Jorgan Hage , Ramses Overdark and Nicol Bolas , ending the Madara-Edemi War .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The emperor charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis and punishes Umezawa and Overdark, placing Umezawa under Elsdragon and keeping Overdark out of the campaign.
timeline.quote: He charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha kills Leshrac's shadow assassin Dinne il-Vec on Madara.
timeline.quote: Radha fought the shadow warrior

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo defeats Shasido Mayasi to become imperial champion.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo defeated Shasido in combat and earned the title.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Youth and training". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo reunites with Meha, Tor and Ayesha and sets out to restore the chaotic empire.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo was reunited with Meha, Tor, and Ayesha

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "The aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chiyo mortally wounds Toshi; Night's Reach saves and teleports him to Dominaria, blinding him on Madara.
timeline.quote: She drops off Toshi on Madara and blinds him.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meha levels Overdark's keep and becomes a seventh circle master, cutting Overdark off from his mana.
timeline.quote: Overdark is now cut off from his main mana source.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays the Empress of Madara and reigns as God-Emperor for 150 years.
timeline.quote: eventually slew the then-Empress of Madara

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa destroys the Imperial Shrine with Bolas's body inside.
timeline.quote: Using the Meteor Hammer spell, Tetsuo destroyed the Imperial Shrine while Bolas's physical body was inside

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas escapes the rift and is reborn using Venser's latent spark.
timeline.quote: he was able to finally escape his prison and be fully reborn into the physical world

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Teferi in a duel and tortures him with his touch.
timeline.quote: he tortured him with his mind-shattering touch and ripped his body to pieces

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Leshrac and imprisons him in a mask.
timeline.quote: the latter was defeated after an epic battle and was imprisoned in the mask of the Myojin of Night's Reach

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and a demonic leviathan fight the first planeswalker battle on Dominaria, destroying a third of the continent and causing the first temporal damage.
timeline.quote: Their battle destroyed one-third of the continent and caused the first temporal damage to the plane.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas closes the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac.
timeline.quote: The rift was closed second to last by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara.
timeline.quote: sacrificing Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the Madaran rift.
timeline.quote: sacrificed Leshrac

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A disembodied voice tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: revealing itself to be Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi duels Bolas and is easily defeated, but convinces Bolas of the rifts' dangers and Bolas leaves, swearing vengeance.
timeline.quote: Bolas decides to leave, swearing vengeance on those who had imprisoned him

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the beaches of Madara the Myojin of Night's Reach offers Leshrac a copy of her mask, and Leshrac accepts the bargain to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac accepts the bargain.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac reveals he had been influencing Jeska, paralyzes her and drains her black mana with the mask.
timeline.quote: Leshrac paralyzes her and uses the mask of the Myojin of Night’s Reach to drain Jeska’s black mana and corrosive touch from her time as Phage .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac duels Bolas, drains his black mana, defaces the Talon Gates and decays Bolas's body with Phage's corrosive touch.
timeline.quote: Neither planeswalker can noticeably harm the other until Leshrac defaces the Talon Gates

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals he had been playing Leshrac, skewers him with his tail and traps his essence with the original mask.
timeline.quote: Skewering Leshrac with his tail, the dragon uses the mask to drain and trap Leshrac’s essence, winning the duel.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas restores Jeska, uses Leshrac's trapped essence to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac, and departs Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Bolas then uses Leshrac’s trapped essence to feed and close it, killing the defeated planeswalker.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin and Bolas fight for days, years and generations before returning to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas kills Ugin; the resulting waves fling Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: where Bolas killed Ugin

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Confrontation of the twins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Using Venser's latent spark, Bolas escapes his prison and regains his body from an earlier point in time.
timeline.quote: regaining his body by pulling a copy of it through the rift from an earlier point in time

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Madaran refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas fights and devours a Demonic Leviathan, causing the Shattering of Madara.
timeline.quote: In the end, the dragon relied upon his touch to defeat his foe.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Fighting the leviathan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wasitora, once a fierce foe, becomes one of Madara's greatest protectors.
timeline.quote: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

citation.text: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen (Double Masters 2022, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: About -15,000 AR Nicol Bolas and a Demonic Leviathan fight to the death at Madara, causing the Shattering and the first Time Rift.
timeline.quote: the first battle between planeswalkers on Dominaria took place at Madara

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A warrior queen founds the Madaran Empire in c. 3226 AR.
timeline.quote: the Madaran Eempire was founded by a warrior queen

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays the warrior-queen in 3455 AR and takes the empire as god-emperor.
timeline.quote: the dragon slew the warrior-queen in 3455 AR, and took the empire

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War Bolas makes Ramses Overdark imperial regent as Overdark replaces other officers.
timeline.quote: Bolas then made a new system with only one placeholder for the emperor

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa kills Overdark and exiles Bolas; the empire falls into chaos.
timeline.quote: former champion Tetsuo Umezawa killed Overdark and exiled Bolas

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overdark launches an aggressive campaign against the Edemi Islands with the Emperor's approval.
timeline.quote: launched an aggressive campaign against the islands

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Emperor orders Elsdragon to invade the Edemis; Hage assassinates Elsdragon and seizes command.
timeline.quote: Hage, now under Overdark’s control, took advantage of the chaos to assassinate Elsdragon

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Umezawa renounces his title and vows to overthrow Overdark and the Emperor; the Emperor paralyzes Overdark.
timeline.quote: renounced his title and vowed to overthrow both Overdark and the Emperor

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo renounces the title of imperial champion after Bolas makes Overdark regent, swears vengeance and destroys both Overdark and Bolas.
timeline.quote: He swore vengeance and destroyed both Overdark and Bolas.

citation.text: "Clan Umezawa", section "Tetsuo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overdark has Hage murder Elsdragon and promotes Hage to general once regent.
timeline.quote: Overdark wanted Elsdragon replaced by someone he could control more easily

citation.text: "Kentsu", section "Generals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meha completes his pilgrimage and stays with Tetsuo.
timeline.quote: His pilgrimage was completed

citation.text: "Kolo Meha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas fights a demonic leviathan for a month in the first planeswalker duel, creating the first spatial rift.
timeline.quote: The fight lasted a month, reduced Madara to a third of its original size, and created the first spatial rift

citation.text: "Leviathan", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Night's Reach takes Toshi's eyesight and banishes him to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Shattering of Madara concluded the era as the world's first clash involving Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Mythohistory", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
